programs.title: Gulmohar
programs.desc: With only 4 days left to vacate their home of 34 years, the Batra family finds themselves entangled in chaos and uncertainty about the future.

programs.title: The 39 Steps
programs.desc: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage Agent. But when the Agent is killed, and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring which is trying to steal top secret information.

programs.title: The Tracker
programs.desc: Three mounted policemen chase a fugitive in the Australian outback. It's 1922, and their leader is an Aboriginal guide. Disagreements gradually arise within the group, partly as a result of violent incidents, and questions never before asked arise: what divides blacks and whites, and who has the right to rule? Rolf de Heer abandons the singular \.

programs.title: Monster
programs.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programs.title: Girl America
programs.desc: Girl America tells the emotional journey of a girl growing up under communist Czechoslovakia, facing hardship and fighting for redemption and hope for a better life in America.

programs.title: Blood Quantum
programs.desc: The indigenous people in the isolated reserve of Red Crow are immune to the zombie plague that has taken over the nation, but that doesn’t mean their lives aren’t at risk. It’s up to Traylor (Michael Greyeyes, ‘Fear the Walking Dead’), the tribal sheriff, to protect the families residing on the reserve and a flood of desperate refugees from the hordes of bloodthirsty, walking white corpses that are closing in.
